overview.zh: 此图追踪上位机从串口选择框取得端口后，如何避免空选择或重复打开，并调用 HandBackend 建立 P4 串口连接。它描述的是桌面端代码路径；“connect 返回成功”与“设备已经完成状态同步”并非同一件事，入口状态栏明确显示仍在等待下位状态和舵机反馈。
overview.en: This graph follows the desktop path from selecting a serial port through empty-selection and already-connected guards to `HandBackend.connect`. It describes host-side code, not proof that a device has completed synchronization: the UI first reports that it is waiting for lower-level status and servo feedback.

zh.plain: 串口连接工作流。用户从端口下拉框选择串口后，UI 才进入端口校验和连接函数；该图把代码中的三种关键分支拆开，便于区分“未选择”“已经连接”和“尝试新连接”。
zh.condition: 用户改变端口选择时触发此流程；需要一个可用的串口选择值。图中没有证明端口对应的实体设备当前在线。
zh.effect: 后续按顺序读取 `port_combo.currentData()`，检查是否为空、检查 backend 是否已连接，再尝试 `backend.connect(port)`。
zh.failure: 空选择会清空当前端口标记并显示提示；已有连接会直接返回；新连接失败则弹出连接失败对话框。
zh.recovery: 若端口列表没有目标设备，先确认系统端口及设备驱动后重新选择；连接失败则检查选中端口、线缆和设备状态。物理恢复过程不由这些代码证明。
zh.unknown: 代码能说明 UI 调用和返回分支，不能证明实际串口打开成功后的通信质量或设备运行状态。
zh.difference: 这是 host UI 的串口建立路径，不是 P4 固件的状态机，也不等同于 ROS2 控制授权。
zh.change: 基线未标记该流程为本次变更。

en.plain: Serial connection workflow. After the user chooses a port in the dropdown, the UI validates it and enters the connection handler. The graph separates three cases: no selection, already connected, and a new connection attempt.
en.condition: The workflow is entered when the port selection changes and requires a selected port value. The graph does not prove that a physical device on that port is online.
en.effect: The handler reads `port_combo.currentData()`, checks for an empty value, checks whether the backend is already connected, and then attempts `backend.connect(port)`.
en.failure: An empty selection clears the current-port marker and displays a status message; an existing connection returns early; a failed new connection shows a critical dialog.
en.recovery: If the desired port is absent, check OS ports and device drivers before selecting again. If connection fails, inspect the selected port, cable, and device. The source does not establish a physical recovery procedure.
en.unknown: The code establishes UI calls and return branches, not communication quality or device state after opening the port.
en.difference: This is the host UI serial setup path, not the P4 firmware state machine or ROS2 control authorization.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this workflow as changed.

zh.plain: `_connect_selected_port()` 是实际的连接处理函数。它先从 `port_combo.currentData()` 取得当前选择，再依次处理无端口、已有连接、连接初始化和 backend 连接结果。
zh.condition: 原始判断包括 `port is None`（是否选到端口）、`self.is_comm_connected()`（是否已有连接）和 `self.backend.connect(port)`（新连接是否成功）。`port` 来自组合框当前项。
zh.effect: 新连接路径会注册状态回调、清空旧状态缓冲和实时显示、设置“等待下位状态和舵机反馈”的提示，再调用 `self.backend.connect(port)`。成功时保存 `current_port`、读取 `last_sync_status`、调用 `_on_comm_ready()`；失败时弹出 `Cannot open port` 对话框。
zh.failure: `port is None` 时显示 `No serial port selected` 并返回 False。已连接时显示 `Already connected` 并返回 True。backend 返回 False 时显示连接失败对话框并返回 False。
zh.recovery: 选择有效端口后重试。若 backend 连接失败，先查看 UI 对话框与串口占用；源代码证据未说明自动重试机制。
zh.unknown: 串口打开后何时收到首个有效 P4 状态、同步超时如何处理，不在此函数片段中完整说明。
zh.difference: 该函数的 True 返回有两种情况：已经连接，或 backend.connect 成功。它不表示已验证所有后续反馈都正常。
zh.change: 基线未标记该连接处理函数为本次变更。

en.plain: `_connect_selected_port()` is the connection handler. It reads the current value from `port_combo.currentData()`, then handles no selection, an existing connection, initialization, and the backend result in order.
en.condition: The raw checks are `port is None` (whether a port was selected), `self.is_comm_connected()` (whether a connection already exists), and `self.backend.connect(port)` (whether the new connection succeeds). `port` comes from the current combo-box item.
en.effect: The new-connection path registers the state callback, clears old state buffers and live displays, shows a waiting-for-lower-status-and-servo-feedback message, and calls `self.backend.connect(port)`. On success it saves `current_port`, reads `last_sync_status`, and calls `_on_comm_ready()`. On failure it shows a `Cannot open port` dialog.
en.failure: If `port is None`, it reports `No serial port selected` and returns False. If already connected, it reports `Already connected` and returns True. If the backend returns False, it shows a connection-failed dialog and returns False.
en.recovery: Select a valid port and retry. If backend connection fails, inspect the dialog and whether the port is occupied; the cited source does not show automatic retry.
en.unknown: The excerpt does not fully establish when the first valid P4 state arrives or how synchronization timeout is handled.
en.difference: This function can return True either because a connection already existed or because `backend.connect` succeeded. True does not prove all later feedback is healthy.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this handler as changed.

zh.plain: 第一个守卫检查端口选择是否为空。`None` 表示下拉框当前没有可连接的端口值，因此这是提前拒绝连接的输入检查。
zh.condition: 原始条件：`port is None`。`port` 来自 `self.port_combo.currentData()`；比较为真表示没有选中可用条目。
zh.effect: 条件为真时将 `current_port` 清空、更新状态为 `No serial port selected` 并返回 False，因此不会调用 backend.connect。条件为假时继续到“是否已连接”的判断。
zh.failure: 真分支拒绝本次连接请求；假分支不代表串口已经打开，只表示后续可继续检查。
zh.recovery: 从端口列表选择一个有效项目，再触发连接流程。若列表为空，检查系统端口枚举和设备连接。
zh.unknown: 源码没有说明 combo 数据为何为空或端口枚举失败时的详细提示。
zh.difference: `None` 是 UI 端口选择缺失，不是 P4 报告的通信故障码。
zh.change: 基线未标记该守卫为本次变更。

en.plain: The first guard checks whether the selected port value is empty. `None` means the combo box has no connectable port value, so this is an input check that rejects the attempt early.
en.condition: Raw condition: `port is None`. `port` comes from `self.port_combo.currentData()`; true means no usable item is selected.
en.effect: When true, the handler clears `current_port`, sets status to `No serial port selected`, and returns False, so `backend.connect` is not called. When false, execution proceeds to the already-connected check.
en.failure: The true branch rejects this attempt. The false branch only permits further checks; it does not mean the serial port is already open.
en.recovery: Select a valid item from the port list and retry. If the list is empty, inspect OS port enumeration and device connection.
en.unknown: The source does not explain why the combo data is empty or give detailed port-enumeration failure handling.
en.difference: `None` means the UI has no selected port; it is not a P4 communication fault code.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this guard as changed.

zh.plain: 第二个守卫避免重复建立串口连接。它检查 backend 当前是否已连接；若已连接，当前操作只更新提示并复用现状，不再重新打开端口。
zh.condition: 原始条件：`self.is_comm_connected()`。真表示 backend 报告已连接；假表示允许走初始化和新连接路径。
zh.effect: 真时状态栏显示 `Already connected: {current_port}` 并返回 True。假时注册回调、清理状态，再调用 backend.connect。
zh.failure: 真分支不是错误，而是幂等式提前返回；假分支后续连接仍可能失败。
zh.recovery: 若目标是切换端口，应先走端口变化处理中的断开/切换逻辑，再连接新端口；仅再次调用此函数不会强制重连。
zh.unknown: 连接状态判定的底层实现和设备是否仍响应未在本守卫片段中证明。
zh.difference: 此守卫只判断通信连接状态，不检查 P4 当前控制模式或安全许可。
zh.change: 基线未标记该守卫为本次变更。

en.plain: The second guard prevents opening a duplicate serial connection. It checks whether the backend is already connected; if so, the handler updates the status and reuses that connection instead of reopening the port.
en.condition: Raw condition: `self.is_comm_connected()`. True means the backend reports connected; false allows initialization and a new attempt.
en.effect: When true, the UI displays `Already connected: {current_port}` and returns True. When false, it registers callbacks, clears state, and calls `backend.connect`.
en.failure: The true branch is an idempotent early return, not an error. The false branch can still fail later.
en.recovery: To switch ports, use the port-change path that disconnects/switches first. Calling this handler again does not force a reconnect.
en.unknown: The implementation of the connectivity check and whether the device is still responding are not established by this guard excerpt.
en.difference: This guard checks communication connectivity, not P4 control mode or safety authorization.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this guard as changed.

zh.plain: 第三个守卫是实际的 backend 连接尝试。它不只是检查变量：`self.backend.connect(port)` 会尝试打开所选串口，并以布尔结果决定 UI 成功或失败分支。
zh.condition: 原始条件：`self.backend.connect(port)`。真表示 backend 报告 connect 成功；假表示打开/初始化连接失败。`backend` 是 `HandBackend`，`port` 是组合框选择值。
zh.effect: 真时保存端口号、显示 Connected 和可选同步状态，再调用 `_on_comm_ready()`。假时弹出 `Cannot open port` 对话框并返回 False。
zh.failure: 假分支使该次连接未建立；源码显示对话框，不显示自动重试。即便为真，也不证明舵机反馈已到达。
zh.recovery: 根据失败对话框检查端口是否正确、是否被其他进程占用，再重新选择/尝试。
zh.unknown: 串口协议同步和下位机首次反馈由后续异步路径处理，成功条件的内部细节未完全展开。
zh.difference: 它是操作性调用，和前两个纯状态/输入守卫不同；成功是后端连接结果而非用户界面授权状态。
zh.change: 基线未标记该调用守卫为本次变更。

en.plain: The third guard is the actual backend connection attempt. It does more than inspect a variable: `self.backend.connect(port)` tries to open the selected serial port and its boolean result selects the UI success or failure branch.
en.condition: Raw condition: `self.backend.connect(port)`. True means the backend reports a successful connect; false means opening or initializing the connection failed. `backend` is a `HandBackend`; `port` is the combo-box selection.
en.effect: On true, the UI stores the port, displays Connected with optional sync status, and calls `_on_comm_ready()`. On false, it shows a `Cannot open port` dialog and returns False.
en.failure: The false path leaves this attempt unconnected; the source shows a dialog, not automatic retry. Even true does not prove servo feedback has arrived.
en.recovery: Use the dialog to check the port and whether another process owns it, then select/retry.
en.unknown: Protocol synchronization and first lower-device feedback occur on later paths; the internal success criteria are not fully shown here.
en.difference: Unlike the first two input/state guards, this is an operational call. Success is the backend connection result, not a user-interface authorization state.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this call guard as changed.

zh.plain: 连接处理函数先检查当前端口值；该边进入“没有选择端口”的提前返回分支。
zh.condition: 原始条件：`port is None`。为真时走拒绝路径；为假时端口值存在，继续检查连接状态。
zh.effect: 真：清空 current_port、显示未选串口并返回 False。假：进入下一个守卫。
zh.failure: 条件为真时没有选中端口，清空标记并返回 False；条件为假时端口值存在，继续检查现有连接。
zh.recovery: 真时在下拉框选择端口；若无可选端口，先排查枚举。
zh.unknown: 后续端口打开结果不由该条件决定。
zh.difference: 条件拆解的是输入有效性，而非硬件在线性。
zh.change: 基线未把这条条件关系标记为本次变更；其连接含义按当前源码说明。

en.plain: Flow from the connection handler into the empty-port check.
en.condition: Raw condition: `port is None`. True takes the rejection path; false means a value exists and the handler checks connection status next.
en.effect: True: clear `current_port`, show that no port is selected, and return False. False: enter the next guard.
en.failure: When true, no port is selected, so the handler clears the marker and returns False; when false, a port exists and the handler checks for an existing connection.
en.recovery: For true, choose a port in the dropdown. If none are listed, investigate port enumeration first.
en.unknown: The later result of opening the port is independent of this condition.
en.difference: This condition tests input validity, not whether hardware is online.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this edge as changed.

zh.plain: 端口值存在后，检查 backend 是否已经连接。
zh.condition: 原始条件：`self.is_comm_connected()`。真时短路返回；假时初始化并发起新连接。
zh.effect: 真：显示当前端口已连接并返回 True。假：继续到状态清理和 connect 调用。
zh.failure: 条件为真时显示当前端口已连接并返回 True；条件为假时继续清理旧状态并尝试建立新连接。
zh.recovery: 想切换端口时使用先断开再连接的路径；已连接只需继续使用现有连接。
zh.unknown: 此条件不验证连接后的实时反馈质量。
zh.difference: 这是防重复连接的状态判断。
zh.change: 基线未把这条条件关系标记为本次变更；其连接含义按当前源码说明。

en.plain: Once a port value exists, the handler checks whether the backend is already connected.
en.condition: Raw condition: `self.is_comm_connected()`. True short-circuits; false initializes state and attempts a new connection.
en.effect: True: report the current port as already connected and return True. False: continue to state cleanup and `connect`.
en.failure: When true, the UI reports the current port as connected and returns True; when false, it clears old state and attempts a new connection.
en.recovery: To switch ports, use the path that disconnects first. If already connected, keep using the existing connection.
en.unknown: The condition does not validate the quality of live feedback after connection.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this edge as changed.

zh.plain: 若端口有效且尚未连接，则调用 backend 实际打开连接。
zh.condition: 原始条件：`self.backend.connect(port)`。真/假分别表示 backend 的布尔返回值；不要把“port 非空”当作连接成功。
zh.effect: 真：记住端口、显示 Connected、运行 `_on_comm_ready()`。假：弹出 Cannot open port 并返回 False。
zh.failure: 调用结果为真时保存端口并进入就绪回调；结果为假时显示 Cannot open port 并返回 False。
zh.recovery: 假时先检查端口占用和设备，再重试；真但无状态时继续检查通信同步和反馈处理。
zh.unknown: backend 内部为何失败、底层异常类别和超时细节未从此片段确定。
zh.difference: 这条边关联一个有副作用的设备调用，和前两个本地判断有本质区别。
zh.change: 基线未把这条条件关系标记为本次变更；其连接含义按当前源码说明。

en.plain: If the port exists and the backend is not already connected, call the backend to open the connection.
en.condition: Raw condition: `self.backend.connect(port)`. True/false are the backend’s boolean result; a non-empty port does not guarantee success.
en.effect: True: save the port, show Connected, and run `_on_comm_ready()`. False: show `Cannot open port` and return False.
en.failure: When the call returns true, the UI saves the port and enters the ready callback; when false, it shows Cannot open port and returns False.
en.recovery: For false, inspect port ownership and device state before retrying. For true with no state, inspect communication synchronization and feedback handling.
en.unknown: The backend’s internal failure causes, exception types, and timeout details are not established by this excerpt.
en.difference: This edge represents a device-side operation with side effects, unlike the first two local checks.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this edge as changed.
